records.question: What was the aggregate net margin of non-financial companies in 2024?
records.generated_sql:
WITH non_financial_companies AS (
    SELECT lei, company_name
    FROM company
    WHERE is_financial = false
)
SELECT 
    fiscal_year, 
    SUM(net_profit) / SUM(revenue) AS net_margin
FROM 
    company_year 
JOIN 
    non_financial_companies ON company_year.lei = non_financial_companies.lei
WHERE 
    fiscal_year = 2024
GROUP BY 
    fiscal_year;
records.executed_sql: WITH non_financial_companies AS (SELECT lei, company_name FROM company WHERE is_financial = FALSE) SELECT fiscal_year, SUM(net_profit) / SUM(revenue) AS net_margin FROM company_year JOIN non_financial_companies ON company_year.lei = non_financial_companies.lei WHERE fiscal_year = 2024 GROUP BY fiscal_year LIMIT 200

records.question: Which company had the largest increase in revenue from 2023 to 2024, in euros?
records.generated_sql:
WITH revenue_change AS (
    SELECT 
        lei, 
        company_name, 
        fiscal_year, 
        value_eur AS revenue
    FROM 
        financial_fact
    WHERE 
        metric = 'revenue'
)
SELECT 
    c1.company_name, 
    c1.revenue - c2.revenue AS revenue_change_eur
FROM 
    revenue_change c1
JOIN 
    revenue_change c2 ON c1.lei = c2.lei AND c1.fiscal_year = 2024 AND c2.fiscal_year = 2023
ORDER BY 
    revenue_change_eur DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
records.executed_sql: WITH revenue_change AS (SELECT lei, company_name, fiscal_year, value_eur AS revenue FROM financial_fact WHERE metric = 'revenue') SELECT c1.company_name, c1.revenue - c2.revenue AS revenue_change_eur FROM revenue_change AS c1 JOIN revenue_change AS c2 ON c1.lei = c2.lei AND c1.fiscal_year = 2024 AND c2.fiscal_year = 2023 ORDER BY revenue_change_eur DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
records.reference_sql:
SELECT a.company_name FROM company_year a
JOIN company_year b ON b.lei = a.lei AND b.fiscal_year = 2023
WHERE a.fiscal_year = 2024 AND a.revenue IS NOT NULL AND b.revenue IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.revenue - b.revenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: ¿Cuál fue el ratio agregado de patrimonio neto sobre activos de bancos y aseguradoras en 2024?

WITH financial_data AS (
    SELECT 
        fiscal_year,
        SUM(total_equity) AS total_equity_sum,
        SUM(total_assets) AS total_assets_sum
    FROM

    WHERE 
        is_financial = true AND fiscal_year = 2024
    GROUP BY

)
SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    total_equity_sum / total_assets_sum AS equity_ratio
FROM 
    financial_data;

records.question: ¿Qué empresas informaron ingresos en 2024 pero no resultado de explotación?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM company c
JOIN filing f ON c.lei = f.lei
JOIN financial_fact ff ON f.filing_id = ff.filing_id
WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2024
  AND ff.metric = 'revenue' AND ff.value_eur IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM financial_fact ff2
    WHERE f.filing_id = ff2.filing_id
      AND ff2.metric = 'operating_profit' AND ff2.value_eur IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY c.name;
records.executed_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM company AS c JOIN filing AS f ON c.lei = f.lei JOIN financial_fact AS ff ON f.filing_id = ff.filing_id WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2024 AND ff.metric = 'revenue' AND ff.value_eur IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM financial_fact AS ff2 WHERE f.filing_id = ff2.filing_id AND ff2.metric = 'operating_profit' AND ff2.value_eur IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 200
